purpose: Pseudo-label adaptation test (27 Sep 2026, the user's 'swing big'). The 2026 ranking months differ from 2025 (docs/input_shift/: LFPG EOBT_1 semantics, LTFM IOBT convention, new stands) and no 2025 development fold can see that. If the scored period's own ADS-B-seen departures, pseudo-labelled from their surface traces with fitting-row statistics only, are added to the fit, do the scored period's OTHER rows (dark, unmatched) improve? Simulated on December 2025 (its true labels only score): ctx_e32 refit fold (Jan-Nov) + December gate rows (pg) or gate+dark rows (pgd), seed-matched to GPU development seeds 401/402/404 (seed 403's node failed); controls = those seeds' December leaf predictions.

features.contract: the x19 committee learners: 276 timeline bundle features + 27 ADS-B departure/neighbour features + 11 v19 features (314)

readings: 3-seed means vs control means on December non-LIRF rows: all, gate, dark, unmatched (the target is dark + unmatched, which pseudo-labels do not cover for pg), by airport; paired-day interval
go: December non-LIRF dark+unmatched rows at least 0.5% lower RMSE with the paired-day interval below zero -> then a declared 2026 version (January/July 2026 traces) with its own checks; shipping it needs the user's decision (it uses flights' own post-pushback ADS-B as training targets)
